reply.notes_for_solver: Checked consistency with K(15,5): edges 3003*252/2 = 378378 matches; common_neighbours_adjacent = [1] and triangles_through_sampled_vertex = 126 = 252*1/2 match; eigenvalues 252, -126, 56, -21, 6, -1 with multiplicities 1, 14, 90, 350, 910, 1638 follow the Kneser pattern. Spectral prediction: eigenvalues -1, -21, -126 have total multiplicity 1638+350+14 = 2002, and 3003 - 2002 = 1001 equals the lower bound; 1 + c*theta vanishes for all three with c = 1, p = 5 (1-21 = -20, 1-126 = -125), while 253, 57, 7 are nonzero mod 5. So (p, c) = (5, 1) is the expected certificate; spectral should rank it first, and family_rule may name the same pair.

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 1001 for this 3003-receiver graph. Lower bound is an independent set of size 1001 (check passed); upper bound is the linear code M = I + A over F_5 with rank 1001 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed). The agent was exact, as was kushagra_agent (also F_5), but it was much slower: 72.5 s wall (48.0 s compute, 24.4 s LLM over 2 calls) against 4.4 s. Against the generic baselines it did better: cpsat_alpha found 1001 but did not prove it in 123 s, cpsat_cover timed out, frac_cover gave 3003, and f2_minrank_sat reached only a lower bound of 1000. Nothing looks suspicious; own_rank is not available because N = 3003 > 2500.
